outcome: miRNA expression profiles (hsa-mir-124-3p, hsa-mir-1285-5p, hsa-mir-331-5p, hsa-miR-30e-5p, hsa-miR-142-3p, hsa-miR-338-3p, hsa-miR-34b-3p, hsa-miR-497-5p, hsa-miR-98-5p, hsa-mir-145-5p)
cohort: The study included 49 neonates with a gestational age of at least 36 weeks, comprising 15 neonates with perinatal asphyxia and 34 healthy controls.
finding: Specific miRNA expression profiles were found to be significantly associated with perinatal asphyxia, HIE requiring therapeutic hypothermia, and poor long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes in neonates.
